plain_B_estimate: Conservatively use the corresponding measured B+D time.
reserve_policy: Round up after 30% allowance; planning allowance, not confidence interval.
actual_rental_price: not supplied; examples are assumptions, not a platform quotation
includes: Measured steady epochs include training, clean validation, audit, checkpoint and history writes.
projection_limit: Two steady epochs per condition; 3000 training data have not been run. Scaling the full epoch by six conservatively scales the fixed 500-validation overhead too. Reserve covers startup, post-training evaluation and ordinary variation; re-budget if actual timing differs by more than 30%.
